## IWebAppAnswerBlock type

Web-app answer block for query answers without template content.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IWebAppAnswerBlock = {
    text: string;
};
```

## Remarks

Declared with `<g-web-app-answer>` blocks. `renderWebAppAnswer` carries a caller-built result, so the block exists only as fail-fast validation that the template provides the required `AGBaseId`<!-- -->. `text` supports the same `{{var|filter}}` interpolation pipeline as poll questions.

This is the block `renderWebAppAnswer` prefers; `<g-answer-note>` remains accepted for it as a legacy alias.

## Example


```typescript
const note: IWebAppAnswerBlock = {
  text: `Web app answer`
}
```
